claims.statement: For all t,k>=0 and affine phases a,b,c, every physical restriction of F_{t,k}^{a,b,c}(x,y,z)=(-1)^{x.y+a.x+b.y+c.z}(1-2*1_{(y,z)=0}), every pure affine-quadratic boundary, and every finite disjoint product of these blocks satisfies G(f)<=64 I(f).
claims.quantifiers: Unbounded rank t, positive codimension k, dimension, restriction depth and disjoint-block count; every affine phase; genuine Boolean signs; base-2 units.

claims.statement: On the same restriction-closed class, U(f)<=64 I(f), H(f)<=130 I(f), and the sharper direct bound H(f)<=4 I(f) holds; the direct constant 4 is sharp along raw point defects.
claims.scope_note: Proper expanding class only; this does not settle full FEI.

claims.statement: The stronger inequality G<=(5/2)I for the scalar generator family survived all archived scalar scans.
claims.scope_note: Not proved, not used, and not a universal FEI statement.

claims.statement: No dimension-independent control of the aggregate upper-set asymmetry mismatch is proved for arbitrary positive-dimensional fibers with changing Boolean coherent cores and reused physical variables.
claims.delta: The gap is removed for one canonical matched bilinear block with one point-defect cylinder for all rank and codimension, but not for arbitrary fiber cores or interacting cylinders.
